title: Apoorva Sangama
desc: Brothers Raj and Shankar choose opposing paths after goons murder their father. Raj turns outlaw seeking vengeance, Shankar joins the police force.
A gangster deploys two of his trusted men in different cities to extort money from people who have escaped. While on their mission, they find themselves in various adventurous situations.

title: Clap
desc: An ambitious athlete gets his dreams shattered following a devastating injury. Later, he coaches a young talent and fights against corrupt officials.

title: Chikkejamanru
desc: A sinister man tries to defame the village landlord and create trouble for the village. However, the landlord is determined to stand tough against all the allegations.

title: Chandra Chakori
desc: Puttaraju and Sevanthi fall in love with each other. Sevanthi's father puts forth a condition for their marriage which Puttaraju must fulfil.
